corinthians2.13.p1.b1.text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”

corinthians2.13.p1.b2.text: …If I return, I will not spare anyone…

corinthians2.13.p1.b3.text: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him…

corinthians2.13.p1.b4.text: …yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.

corinthians2.13.p2.b1.text: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves.

corinthians2.13.p2.b2.text: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.

corinthians2.13.p2.b3.text: …the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

corinthians2.13.p3.b2.text: Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

corinthians2.13.p3.b3.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

corinthians2.13.p3.b4.text: All the saints send you greetings.

corinthians2.13.p4.b1.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
